displayName: Job publish-world-results: failed or not run

documentation.content: The job that publishes the world results once a day failed, or has not finished well for a day, so the app keeps showing the results of the day before. Open Cloud Run, Jobs, `publish-world-results`, and its last execution's logs; if there is none, open Cloud Scheduler, `publish-world-results`, and its last attempt (a 403 means the scheduler account may not run the job). Run it again with `gcloud run jobs execute publish-world-results --region europe-southwest1`.

conditions.displayName: No execution finished well in a day
